description: A function whose body contains `yield`; calling it returns a generator and runs none of the body.
The iterator a generator function returns; each `next()` runs the paused frame to the next `yield`.
Between two `next()` calls the generator keeps its local variables, loop position and open `try` blocks.
Since Python 3.7 a `StopIteration` escaping inside a generator body is turned into `RuntimeError`.
A generator with no natural end, safe only with a bounded consumer such as `next`, `zip` or `islice`.
